verdicts.note: All-girls school plus repeated self-references as a woman in factory/course confirm female.
Main school was an all-girls (single-sex) school; comprehensive was only for DT classes.
Doing the design technology course (R&D placement); D&T department confirmed despite quote being A-levels.
Currently on industrial placement in R&D = placement year.
Chose D&T 'cause I enjoy it' / wanted to do more = agree on interesting work; no emphatic marker for strongly agree.
Parents 'not to design no, no' = disagree family member in industry.
Enthusiastic teacher cited as industry contact, not explicit encouragement; mild agree at best, confidence thin.
Careers advice 'wasn't very helpful' = did not encourage = disagree.
Quote is about breadth/doing materials (variety), not whether the LEVEL of practical work is 'just right'; no support for practica.
'a bit harder than I expected... covers a lot of different areas' = agree curriculum harder than expected.
'Yeah definitely' plus later 'quite glad I chose the course' supports strongly agree.
'don't mind it, not too bad' is lukewarm-positive; borderline neutral, satisfied defensible but confidence thin.
'really helpful' and would not want a different tutor supports very satisfied.
'doing a bit of everything... quite enjoyed it' supports satisfied with variety of subjects.
Currently on placement in R&D = yes.
'the experience' first reason given for placement = agree.
'bit more money (laughs)' cited lightly as a want, not a stated need; mild agree only, confidence thin.
Quote is 'more time to prepare myself in the final year' = general prep, not deciding the final-year PROJECT; conflates the two.
'real world based rather than just learning about it in lectures' = agree wanting idea of what industry is like.
Interviewer-prompted retrospective ('good to have experience... know what I'm going into'); not stated as a motivation; mild agree at best.
Reasons voluntary/personal, placement not compulsory ('would do a placement again') = other.
Enjoys R&D, wants same area/'development side', rejects design consultancy = research/development.
'technical well sort of specialist, technical' directly supports technical/specialist.
